title: Tick Phase
description: Checklist with a phase-coloured tinted-ring tick marker and a divider between items, for the individual service pages (the marker and divider follow the page's phase via --ls-phase-accent). Typography, text colour, the list reset, item layout, divider, bold weight and the `ls-tick-phase--compact` className modifier (tighter rows for smaller text) all live here; only the ::before tick marker is in src/scss/structural/tick-phase.scss, because a content:"" pseudo-element is on AGENTS.md's list of things a JSON style cannot express. Unlike Tick Accent, which is a solid brand-coloured circle.
